request.purpose: We want to align private health insurance premiums for customers with this condition with their actual risk.
request.question: What share of older patients with heart failure has an active beta blocker, per hospital?
definitions: Older patient = aged 65 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Beta blocker = ATC code starting with C07AB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: older patients with heart failure and % with an active beta blocker, one decimal.
